scenarios.title: Real stock miner attaches an actual asteroid target
steps: Boot a disposable pinned EveJS world in Perimeter 30000144 with real asteroid sites and native stock mining enabled
Inspect loaded SpaceRuntime.scenes and actual stock fleet miner itemID and assigned asteroid
Capture scene target-lock IDs and active mining effect targetIDs
expected: Genuine mineable target exists, lock and active effect target match
A combat controllerTarget=0 does not count as mining failure

scenarios.title: Positive actual native ore cargoID growth across two samples
steps: Observe an authentic NPC miner with empty or previously known native cargo
Sample after two 30-second ALIFE mining witness ticks
expected: Only positive matched ore cargo growth reports NATIVE_ORE_GROWTH_CONFIRMED
Same cargoID+quantity on another tick is not extra mined ore

scenarios.title: No target lock, no mineable effects and lack of modules
steps: Disable or remove real miner target lock in disposable test scene without destroying preserved data
Restore lock but remove active module effect
Run strict local mining world gate
expected: Every failed native proof names blocker, no positive mining result
No artificial ore, repair tool or phantom advancement
requiredEvidence: world report blocker after each action

scenarios.title: Authoritative cargo identity and NPC ownership safety
steps: Make duplicated/invalid owner or transient native ore row in an isolated test fixture
Attempt to reference player ship as an NPC miner
Verify minable guard and strict read-only auditing
expected: Forged cargo never counts as proof of production
No mutation occurs in witness module

scenarios.title: Physical miner to hauler to station stock
steps: Observe positive original native cargoID growth from a real miner
Allow existing native haul cargo reparent without changing cargoID
Verify native station route, warehouse COMMITTED receipt and itemStore unique cargo tag
expected: Exactly one positive ore source delivered to matching warehouse owner and station
Neither ALIFE witness nor plan creates new ore or credits ISK
requiredEvidence: full manifest COMMITTED and itemStore receipt

scenarios.title: Two clients see actual mining and know when it stalls
steps: Connect two authorized local clients to a disposable Perimeter world
Watch physical asteroid lock, module visual activity, ore growth or named blocker
Run world report --require-mining-yield on server log
expected: Both clients see same stock hull and real asteroid interaction
Only actual native ore delta satisfies report, never a mining state flag
requiredEvidence: same systemID, shipID, cargoID and two witness samples
